info.name: HIGHFLIER Backend API
info.description:
Postman collection generated from the OpenAPI document.

1. Set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`).
2. Run **Auth → POST /auth/login** to store `accessToken` (or set it manually).
3. Run **Catalogue → GET /products** then **Admin → GET /admin/products** to capture a product id and SKU.
4. Checkout and supplier requests automatically capture `orderId` and `supplierId`.

All mock supplier and mock payment responses are labelled `isMock`/`mock: true`. They are not real fulfilment or real money.

request.description: Returns 503 until MongoDB is connected. Mounted at `/health/ready`.

request.description: Authentication is optional; when present, `mine` flags the caller’s review.
Requires a delivered (or returned) order containing the product. One review per customer per product.

item.name: POST /orders/checkout — Place an order from the cart or explicit items

request.description: Totals are recalculated server-side. Stock is reserved atomically. COD is rejected when any supplier lacks COD capability. Online payments return a gateway checkout payload; COD confirms immediately and forwards supplier orders.

item.name: GET /orders/{id} — Get one of my orders by id or order number

request.description: Get one of my orders by id or order number
Allowed while pending payment, confirmed or processing. Stock is restored and online payments are refunded (mock refund in mock mode).

request.description: The return window is configured by RETURN_WINDOW_DAYS.

item.name: POST /payments/verify — Verify a payment signature and capture the order

request.description: Accepts either camelCase or Razorpay-style snake_case fields. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 over `orderId|paymentId`. Verification is idempotent.

item.name: POST /payments/mock/pay — Simulate a payment (mock mode only)

request.description: Clearly labelled mock endpoint. No real money moves.

item.name: GET /payments/order/{orderId} — List payments for one of my orders

request.description: List payments for one of my orders
Raw-body HMAC verification using RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Events are deduplicated by provider event id. Invalid signatures return 400.

Existing orders retain their immutable snapshots.

item.name: PATCH /admin/reviews/{id} — Approve or reject a review

request.description: Writes an audit record and recomputes the product rating.

item.name: GET /admin/orders/{id} — Get an order with supplier orders

request.description: Get an order with supplier orders
Only transitions allowed by the order state machine are accepted. Marking delivered captures COD payments.

item.name: PATCH /admin/orders/{id}/note — Set the internal admin note

request.description: Partial refunds are supported. Online refunds use the gateway (mock refund in mock mode); COD refunds are manual. Optionally restocks committed items.
